name: module-federation-microfrontends
description: React micro-frontends with Vite and Module Federation

scripts.dev: concurrently -n container,sub-app1,sub-app2 -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w container" "npm run dev -w sub-app1" "npm run dev -w sub-app2"
scripts.build: npm run build -w sub-app1 && npm run build -w sub-app2 && npm run build -w container
scripts.preview: concurrently -n container,sub-app1,sub-app2 -c blue,green,magenta "npm run preview -w container" "npm run preview -w sub-app1" "npm run preview -w sub-app2"
